solution_summary: That scale is the business, and it’s also the challenge. When evaluating cloud platforms, TRLLN's engineering team of more than 50 specialists based in Barcelona centered on one question: which provider could grow with them, not just to millions of devices but toward a vision of one trillion connected assets… In the field, Intelligent Nodes broadcast to Super Nodes by Bluetooth, each Super Node capable of capturing up to 30,000 signals simultaneously. Super Nodes transmit to the cloud using 4G or WiFi. Google Cloud processes the resulting data stream: Cloud DNS… Key components include BigQuery stores and queries the analytics and AI-ready datasets that power the workload; Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) orchestrates the platform's containerized services and high-concurrency workloads; AlloyDB stores transactional state and application data for the operational workflow at low latency; Cloud SQL stores transactional state and application data for the operational workflow at low.
